findings.summary: Peter Thiel biographical profile: German-American billionaire (b.1967 Frankfurt), triple citizenship US/DE/NZ
findings.detail: Born October 11, 1967, Frankfurt am Main. Family emigrated to US age 1. BA Philosophy Stanford 1989, JD Stanford Law 1992. Triple citizenship: US, German, New Zealand (granted 2011 after only 12 days in country). Net worth ~$27.5B (Dec 2025). Co-founded Stanford Review conservative newspaper (1987). Co-authored The Diversity Myth with David Sacks. After law school worked at Sullivan & Cromwell, then as derivatives trader at Credit Suisse. Founded Thiel Capital Management 1996.

Tagged as PEP (Politically Exposed Person) and POI (Person of Interest). Education: Stanford University, Stanford Law School, San Mateo High School. Board positions: 2005-2022 and 2003-present (likely Facebook and Palantir). Political affiliation: Republican Party. No active sanctions.

Stanford Review alumni network: key pipeline to Silicon Valley power. Thiel (1987 founder), David Sacks, Keith Rabois - all became PayPal/VC leaders
findings.detail: The Stanford Review, founded 1987 by Thiel as conservative/libertarian newspaper, became an extraordinary pipeline to power. Alumni include: Peter Thiel (founder, editor 1987-89), David Sacks (editor), Keith Rabois (contributor). Fortune 2023: the Review has quietly become one of the surest paths to success in Silicon Valley. The founding was prompted by Jesse Jacksons Rainbow Coalition march and replacement of Western Culture curriculum. Thiel and Sacks ideological framework was libertarian. Co-wrote Diversity Myth (1995) criticizing Stanford multiculturalism. This shared intellectual formation bonded the future PayPal Mafia.

findings.summary: Thiel business empire: PayPal (1998), Palantir (2003), Facebook investor (2004), Founders Fund ($17B AUM)

Co-founded Palantir Technologies (2003), chairman since inception. First outside Facebook investor ($500K for 10.2%, Aug 2004). Co-founded Founders Fund (2005) with Ken Howery and Luke Nosek - now ~$17B AUM, recently closed $4.6B growth fund (2025). Co-founded Valar Ventures (2010), Mithril Capital (2012) with Ajay Royan. Published Zero to One (2014). Roth IRA grew from <$2K (1999 PayPal shares) to $5B tax-free.
